newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares follow Arab Bank down.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares follow Arab Bank down.

text.p: Shares on the Amman stock exchange fell 0.21 percent at the start of weekly trade on Saturday in quiet trade dominated by a handful of bloc trades in heavyweight Arab Bank.
The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index fell 0.32 points to 155.76 points in turnover of 645,000 dinars ($910,000), nearly half of which was acounted for by trade in Arab Bank.
Brokers said there were few factors driving the market in the absence of international investor interest over the Western weekend.
Arab Bank fell one dinar to 265.50 dinars after shares worth 302,000 dinars changed hands. International Tobacco was unchanged at 1.17 after busy trade worth 156,000 dinars.
International Tobacco stock has fallen 10 percent from 1.31 dinars in recent weeks but brokers expected the company to announce healthy 1996 profits within the next two months.
No other shares topped 25,000 dinars worth of trade. Falling stocks outnumbered gainers by 17 to six and another 12 traded but closed unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 most-traded shares on the exchange fell 0.15 percent to 81.64 points, 2.1 percent down from the start of the year.
